# Murray Legal

Canonical website: https://murraylegalfirm.com
Phone: (914) 214-1880
Email: admin@murraylegalfirm.com

Murray Legal provides strategic legal counsel for businesses, investors, executives, creators, athletes, families, and private clients. Practice areas include corporate law, real estate, civil litigation, entertainment transactions, sports transactions, intellectual property, trusts, wills and estates, and divorce and family law.

Jurisdiction notice: Murray Legal maintains an office location in Yonkers, New York and is currently licensed to practice law in Pennsylvania. The firm may work with clients nationwide where permitted by law, including through local counsel or jurisdiction-appropriate arrangements when necessary. Website content is general information only and does not create an attorney-client relationship.
